alt: La Mar presenta una notícia davant d’un local del barri.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one single landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536×1024, for a Catalan listening-comprehension worksheet and catalogue card, printed around 80 mm wide. Reference images specify only canonical character appearance and established drawing style. Fine naturalistic ink and softly textured muted watercolor, warm paper fading into a generous pure-white border on all four edges; no frame. Warm gentle light, restrained earthy colors. Single coherent specific scene, large readable figures and natural hands, no panels, no labels, writing, numerals, logos or watermark. Keep all reference character faces, ages and clothing consistent; do not include the lettering or layout of the model sheets. Canonical Mar: adult woman with brown ponytail, olive-green blazer over cream shirt, brown eyes. She is reporting outside a neighborhood workshop entrance, holding a reporter microphone loosely at waist level and making a small open-handed gesture toward the entrance. Warm indoor light, a doorway and a workbench only partly glimpsed establish the local-workshop context, but no layout is revealed. Composition should be a candid reporting moment, not a formal portrait. Do not show tools, labels, boxes, furniture legs, stairs, dimensions, maps, opening hours, signs, booking sheets, a repair being performed or a moving operation. No other people.
encoding: WebP quality 90; original composition and dimensions retained.
